axes.why: The plus end backs a range of government bills on employment, welfare, and devolution, while the minus end combines left-wing economic proposals with right-wing measures on human rights and immigration.
plus_args: Pass the Employment Rights Bill
Remove the two-child limit on Universal Credit
Support the Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill
Remove VAT and business rates exemptions for private schools
Support the English Devolution and Community Empowerment Bill
Pass the Northern Ireland Troubles Bill
Pass the Universal Credit and Personal Independence Payment Bill
minus_args: Pass the Terminally Ill Adults (End of Life) Bill
Withdraw from the European Convention on Human Rights
Refer the Prime Minister to the Committee of Privileges over misleading statements about the Mandelson appointment
Return water companies to public ownership
Disapply the Human Rights Act 1998 to immigration and deportation
Introduce rent controls in the Renters’ Rights Bill
End the ban on new oil and gas licences
